subject: expose_stan_functions() giving compilation warnings which get printed in Rmd

messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: expose_stan_functions() giving compilation warnings which get printed in Rmd
parts:
Hi all - 

In an Rmd file, I am using expose_stan_functions(). My 
Rmd options include warning = F, message = F and 
global options include verbose = F.

Despite this, the C++ compilation warnings are printed 
to my document. 

I suspect this is an Rmd issue, but thought I'd check here
if anyone has had this problem? If so, any fixes?

Jim

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: expose_stan_functions() giving compilation warnings which get printed in Rmd
parts:
On Wednesday, July 6, 2016 at 10:27:35 AM UTC-4, James Savage wrote:
I suspect this is an Rmd issue, but thought I'd check here
if anyone has had this problem? If so, any fixes?

You need to put results = "hide" in the options for that chunk.

Ben
